cases.prompt: Review mobile code that builds SQL from user input and evaluates a remotely supplied JavaScript string.
expect: Flags the concrete SQL and code-injection paths
Prioritizes release exploitability over style findings
Recommends parameterization, removal of evaluation, and boundary validation

cases.prompt: Audit a React Native production build that ships debug tooling, verbose sensitive logs, and an unmaintained native dependency.
expect: Finds exploitable release configuration and dependency risks
Separates confirmed evidence from version assumptions
Provides build and dependency verification steps
